# Shared objects reference

Objects used by more than one area, and the metadata of every answer.

## Response objects

Every object implements the interface of the same name in `Contracts\DTO`.

<a name="address"></a>
### `Address`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `bagId()` | `?string` | `bag_id` | BAG nummeraanduiding id. |
| `postcode()` | `?string` | `postcode` | The postcode. |
| `houseNumber()` | `?int` | `house_number` | The house number. |
| `houseNumberExt()` | `?string` | `house_number_ext` | The extension of the house number. |
| `street()` | `?string` | `street` | The street. |
| `city()` | `?string` | `city` | The city. |
| `municipality()` | `?string` | `municipality` | The municipality. |
| `province()` | `?string` | `province` | The province. |
| `location()` | `?`[`Location`](#location) | `location` | The coordinates of the address. |
| `rd()` | `?`[`RdLocation`](#rdlocation) | `rd` | Only with include=rd. |
| `housepediaUrl()` | `?string` | `huispedia_url` | The page of the address on Housepedia. |
| `bagVerblijfsobjectId()` | `?string` | `bag_verblijfsobject_id` | The BAG verblijfsobject id. |
| `bagPandId()` | `?string` | `bag_pand_id` | The BAG pand id of the building. |
| `bagStatus()` | `?string` | `bag_status` | The status of the address in the BAG. |
| `isResidential()` | `?bool` | `is_residential` | Whether the address is a home. |
| `neighbourhood()` | `?`[`AreaReference`](#areareference) | `neighbourhood` | The neighbourhood of the address. |
| `district()` | `?`[`AreaReference`](#areareference) | `district` | The district of the address. |
| `municipalityCode()` | `?string` | `municipality_code` | The CBS code of the municipality. |
| `provinceCode()` | `?string` | `province_code` | The code of the province. |
| `meta()` | `?`[`Meta`](#meta) | `meta` | The metadata of the answer; `null` when the address is part of another answer. |

<a name="areahierarchy"></a>
### `AreaHierarchy`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `neighbourhood()` | `?`[`AreaReference`](#areareference) | `neighbourhood` | The neighbourhood. |
| `district()` | `?`[`AreaReference`](#areareference) | `district` | The district. |
| `municipality()` | `?`[`AreaReference`](#areareference) | `municipality` | The municipality. |
| `province()` | `?`[`AreaReference`](#areareference) | `province` | The province. |
| `meta()` | `?`[`Meta`](#meta) | `meta` | The metadata of the answer; `null` for the areas of a reverse lookup. |

<a name="areareference"></a>
### `AreaReference`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `code()` | `string` | `code` | CBS code, e.g. BU0363KH05. |
| `name()` | `?string` | `name` | The name of the area. |

<a name="confidence"></a>
### `Confidence`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `scorePercentage()` | `?float` | `score_pct` | Probability the value is within 10 percent of a sale price. |
| `class()` | `?string` | `class` | high (≥80), medium (≥60) or low. |
| `within5Percent()` | `?float` | `within_5_pct` | The confidence that the value is within 5% of the estimate. |
| `within10Percent()` | `?float` | `within_10_pct` | The confidence that the value is within 10% of the estimate. |
| `within20Percent()` | `?float` | `within_20_pct` | The confidence that the value is within 20% of the estimate. |

<a name="credits"></a>
### `Credits`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `charged()` | `int` | `charged` | Credits debited for this call. |
| `balance()` | `int` | `balance` | Credits remaining on the account after this call. |

<a name="estimate"></a>
### `Estimate`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `value()` | `int` | `value` | Point estimate in euros. |
| `lower()` | `int` | `lower` | The lower bound of the estimate. |
| `upper()` | `int` | `upper` | The upper bound of the estimate. |
| `interval()` | `?float` | `interval` | Probability that the true value lies between lower and upper. |
| `pricePerSquareMeter()` | `?int` | `price_per_m2` | The estimated value per square metre of living area. |
| `asOfDate()` | `?DateTimeImmutable` | `as_of_date` | The date the estimate applies to. |
| `model()` | `?string` | `model` | The valuation model. |
| `modelVersion()` | `?string` | `model_version` | The month the value was last determined, as year.month. |

<a name="location"></a>
### `Location`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `lat()` | `float` | `lat` | Latitude, WGS84. |
| `lon()` | `float` | `lon` | Longitude, WGS84. |

<a name="meta"></a>
### `Meta`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `requestId()` | `?string` | `request_id` | Unique id of this request; quote it to support. |
| `asOf()` | `?DateTimeImmutable` | `as_of` | The date the data in this response describes. |
| `credits()` | `?`[`Credits`](#credits) | `credits` | The credits charged and the balance after the call. |
| `nextCursor()` | `?string` | `next_cursor` | Cursor for the next page of a list; absent on the last. |
| `withheld()` | `list<string>\|null` | `withheld` | Fields withheld because a source does not permit onward delivery. |
| `rateLimit()` | `?`[`RateLimit`](#ratelimit) | `X-RateLimit-* headers` | The rate limit of the account after the call; `null` for an answer from the cache. |

### `RdLocation`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |

| `x()` | `float` | `x` | RD New (EPSG:28992) x in metres. |
| `y()` | `float` | `y` | RD New (EPSG:28992) y in metres. |

<a name="results"></a>
### `Results`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `data()` | `list<T>` | `data` | The items of the list. |
| `meta()` | `?`[`Meta`](#meta) | `meta` | The metadata of the answer. |
| `getIterator()` | `Traversable<int, T>` |  | Iterates the items with keys from 0. |
| `count()` | `int` |  | The number of items. |

<a name="reverseresults"></a>
### `ReverseResults`

Extends [`Results`](#results).

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `areas()` | `?`[`AreaHierarchy`](#areahierarchy) | `areas` | The areas of the coordinate. |

<a name="ratelimit"></a>
### `RateLimit`

| Method | Returns | Header | Description |
|--------|---------|--------|-------------|
| `limit()` | `int` | `X-RateLimit-Limit` | The number of requests the bucket of the account holds. |
| `remaining()` | `int` | `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | The number of requests left in the bucket. |
| `resetInSeconds()` | `int` | `X-RateLimit-Reset` | The seconds until the bucket is full again. |
| `resetsAt()` | `DateTimeImmutable` |  | The time the answer was received plus `resetInSeconds()`. |
